hero.subtitle: Compassionate, evidence-based treatment in Urology and Paediatrics — under one roof at Kankarbagh, Patna.

about.label: About the Clinic
about.title: A Combined Practice Built on Trust & Expertise
about.p1: The Ayansh Clinic is a premier medical centre in Kankarbagh, Patna, offering specialist care across two critical disciplines — Urology and Paediatrics. Our philosophy is simple: every patient deserves the same standard of care that we would want for our own family.
about.p2: Founded by Dr. Asit Kumar and Dr. Nikki Kumari, the clinic combines years of institutional training from premier medical institutes with a warm, reassuring environment that puts both adults and children at ease.

services.label: What We Offer
services.title: Our Specialisations
services.subtitle: Comprehensive care across two specialities — all under one roof.

kidney.title: Kidney Stone Treatment
kidney.desc: Non-invasive and minimally-invasive options including ESWL, PCNL, and Ureteroscopy for all types of kidney stones.

prostate.title: Prostate Disorders
prostate.desc: Diagnosis and management of BPH, prostatitis, and prostate cancer with modern endoscopic techniques.

cancers.title: Urological Cancers
cancers.desc: Expert management of bladder, kidney, and testicular cancers with organ-preserving surgical options where possible.

infertility.title: Male Infertility
infertility.desc: Comprehensive evaluation and treatment of male factor infertility including varicocele repair and sperm retrieval.

lap.title: Laparoscopic Urology
lap.desc: Minimally invasive laparoscopic and endoscopic procedures for faster recovery and minimal scarring.

uti.title: Urinary Tract Infections
uti.desc: Diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of recurrent UTIs in men and women with detailed microbiological workup.

newborn.title: Newborn & Neonatal Care
newborn.desc: Comprehensive care for newborns including assessment, jaundice management, and feeding support.

growth.title: Growth & Development
growth.desc: Regular monitoring of physical, cognitive, and emotional milestones with early intervention for developmental delays.

vax.title: Vaccination & Immunisation
vax.desc: Complete IAP-recommended immunisation schedules for infants, children, and adolescents.

resp.title: Respiratory Illnesses
resp.desc: Management of asthma, bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and recurrent respiratory infections in children.

infect.title: Paediatric Infections
infect.desc: Diagnosis and treatment of viral, bacterial, and parasitic infections common in childhood.

nutrition.title: Child Nutrition & Diet
nutrition.desc: Counselling for healthy nutrition, management of malnutrition, obesity, and feeding difficulties in children.
